name: Zombie Juice

description: Abercrombie sends travelers from his lonely shack in Duskwood to fetch Zombie Juice in Darkshire. He says the chill of the night leaves him cold.

clips.title: The story
paras: Abercrombie sends travelers from his lonely shack in Duskwood to fetch Zombie Juice in Darkshire. He says the chill of the night leaves him cold.

Abercrombie lives alone among the horrors of Duskwood's shadowed woods and often sends sympathetic travelers on strange errands. He says the creeping dusk drains his warmth and vitality, then asks you to travel east to Darkshire. At the Scarlet Raven Tavern, Tavernkeep Smitts sells the potent drink Abercrombie seeks. Its ominous name is Zombie Juice, and Abercrombie says it will put fire back in his veins.

Tavernkeep Smitts serves weary guards and frightened townsfolk at Darkshire's tavern, but few ask for Zombie Juice. The drink is known for its dangerous strength, and Smitts recognizes the vintage. Abercrombie's taste for such a morbid brew raises quiet eyebrows in a region besieged by the restless dead.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice. Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.
And please hurry, friend. These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need some Zombie Juice, do you? Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.
